svg.title: The Operator: one exceptions queue
svg.desc: Left, the Agent pods, whose paused handlings raise an approval, a problem or a proposal asked into one queue; middle, the queue with those three kinds; right, the Operator at the command line, who answers: approve or refuse, acknowledge, resolve or retry, or propose. Answers are written to the record, and the handling that asked resumes from it. Arrows show who calls whom.
